messages:
Samir (sales): heads up — Kora reported a sharp drop in sustained TPS on their dedicated pool and p95 doubled after last-night routing tweak. they hit 500ms -> 1.2s on chat endpoints. link: https://redwood.metrics/shot/xyz :eyes:
Maria T.: ugh. noticed a small bump in overall p95 on the region dashboards around 02:10 UTC, might line up. any deploys/route changes then?
oncall-bot: Routing policy update deployed by deploy-bot at 2026-03-18T02:08:42Z: policy "region-weighted-fallback-v2" -> active
Kevin L.: I can take initial triage. Samir, can you confirm customer model + q config and whether they pinned a model variant?
Samir (sales): they use gpt-4o-reduced (open-variant) unpinned, customer asked for pinning yesterday but product said not recommended. No dedicated quant applied.
Elena P. (product): Adding context: Kora is on an annual committed Dedicated plan with 99.9% p95 SLA for chat. If this is regresssion due to routing change we need a mitigation within 48h.
AJ: quick ask — do we have KV cache warmup metrics for that tenant? warm cache vs cold cache can explain p95 jumps on sustained bursts.
Kevin L.: pulling logs now. attaching sample from their pool: ```
[2026-03-18T02:09:12Z] req=0x7a3 token_count=128 model=gpt-4o-reduced kernel=amat cpu_sched=normal queue_ms=18 exec_ms=142 nvtx=120
[2026-03-18T02:09:14Z] req=0x7a4 token_count=16 model=gpt-4o-reduced kernel=amat cpu_sched=normal queue_ms=12 exec_ms=760 nvtx=610
```
Maria T.: second line looks like exec_ms spike for short sequence -> kernel mismatch / small-batch serialization maybe. Could be that policy routed to a variant with slow kernel selection for short sequences.
Samir (sales): customer says it started right after you rolled the new routing weights. they want either a rollback or a pinned route for their pool.
Elena P. (product): Decision needed: roll back global routing policy vs. apply targeted override for Kora. Rollback affects others; override is lower blast radius but needs quick config change. Thoughts?
AJ: targeted override is quick: set route policy "pin-to-amat-legacy" for customer pool id cp-4487. It's a single key flip in routing service. Estimate 30m to deploy and observe.
Kevin L.: I recommend override + hotfix to routing selector to ensure short sequences use the legacy kernel until we root cause. We'll also run a small canary revert for 10% traffic to validate.
Maria T.: Plan: 1) apply targeted routing override (30m) 2) monitor p95 for 1h, 3) if stable, keep and schedule perf deep-dive. Create ticket for kernel selection telemetry and batch size distribution.
Samir (sales): Kora asked about temporary dedicated capacity bump while you triage. asks for ETA on override and for a note to legal on SLA impact.
Elena P. (product): We'll tell customer: targeted override in ~30-45m, monitoring for 1h, then update. For capacity bump: need CS/Sales to get explicit approval for additional cost. I can draft statement for legal ops.
oncall-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-3153 — "Kora dedicated p95 regression after routing change". Severity: P1 (customer SLA hit). Pager duty assigned to oncall: Kevin L., escalation: Maria T.
Kevin L.: kicking off override now. applying route key flip to cp-4487 -> pin to amat-legacy.
Maria T.: watching metrics — KPI dashboard: https://redwood.metrics/dash/kora-cp-4487 p95 back to 480ms after override, sustained TPS stable. :thumbsup:
Samir (sales): forwarded to Kora, they acknowledged and appreciate the quick action. requesting a written postmortem and what will prevent recurrence.
Elena P. (product): Next steps / scope negotiation: Engineering asks for 5d of investigation to root cause kernel-selection & policy interactions + a small infra change (route selector sanity checks). Product to decide if we roll fix as emergency patch or include in scheduled 2-week cycle. Engineering prefers emergency patch given SLA customers impacted.
Maria T.: estimate: 2 days to fully reproduce and 3 more for a tested fix if we ship hotfix (5 total). If product deprioritizes, mitigation will remain override and we add monitoring alerts.
Elena P. (product): Given committed customers, I'm greenlighting emergency patch. Product will own release notes and a short customer-facing summary. Please create PRD-lite: problem, impact, target SLA, rollout plan, test cases.
Kevin L.: created ticket ENG-5632, linked INC-2026-3153, assigned to me + backend. PRD-lite checklist incoming.
Samir (sales): Kora asked timeline for when route will be unpinned entirely — will confirm once engineering provides root-cause ETA.
Elena P. (product): Also: negotiate scope with Kora — they pushed to pin model variant permanently. Ops: we need to weigh customer cost + platform complexity. Product will propose: temporary pin + joint test window, then opt-in permanent pin as paid feature.
Maria T.: noted. action items: Kevin -> ENG-5632 triage, Maria -> add kernel selection telemetry dashboards, Elena -> customer comms + legal note, Samir -> CS billing/contract follow-up.
AJ: tagging infra for potential autoscale prewarm for dedicated pools to reduce cold-starts during policy experiments.
Kevin L.: will post updates on ENG-5632 and here if anything changes. thanks. :pray:
